title: Core Octet #45
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 16:9 aspect ratio, significantly wider than it is tall, eight women in a single row.

A photograph of EIGHT women standing side by side in a single row at the same ground level on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, each woman in her own distinct pose, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, all real photographic skin with visible pores, no illustration finish, no CG sheen, all faces, hands and feet in correct proportion. The camera set back so all 8 fit comfortably within the wide frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left to right:
[girl-crush / Powerlifter]: Korean woman, mid 30s, demure and soft, fair ivory skin, sharply angled thin brows, a razor-sharp winged cat-eye liner extending far past the outer corner, deep brown-black eyeshadow, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strongly sculpted contour, a deep wine-red matte lip, long sleek black hair, a cold, commanding gaze, twin-tail hair, stiletto nails (glossy). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an enormous, overwhelmingly powerful woman. Colossal thick trapezius muscle rising high around her neck, massive round boulder shoulders, enormous thick arms with dense hard muscle, a broad powerful back, a deeply carved abdomen, colossal glutes and hips extending far beyond the shoulders, gigantic quadriceps with a deep sweep. Her head looks small on top of her massive frame. Not slim, not a fitness body, powerful and heavy at once. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Japanese Kutani porcelain (a cream-white ground with bold red, gold and green overglaze enamels), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: seated across two steps. Shoes: extreme gold-and-red platform stiletto studded boots.

An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Both her bust and her hips are simultaneously, dramatically enormous — a colossal heavy bust resting full and wide, and enormous round hips flaring just as dramatically wide below — but unlike a sharply cinched hourglass, her waistline stays soft and only gently defined between them, a full, natural figure rather than a snatched one. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body.
